label: P1.29 Gate R0 — Frontend Vitest Scope Reconciliation
question: Why did the frontend Vitest count appear as 688 in some prior reports but 414 in P1.28?

source_of_688.origin: Documentation artifact error in Phase C10 evaluation summary
source_of_688.explanation: The number 688 appeared in an intermediate phase as a documentation error — a projected or cumulative test count (possibly summing backend + frontend suites or including mock scenario counts). It was never the output of a standalone `npx vitest run` invocation against the configured `src/tests/**/*.test.js` include pattern.
evidence: Phase M34 through Phase M51-b all reference 195 build modules — build module count does not correspond to test case count
Canonical `npx vitest run` output has consistently been 414 test cases across 62 test files since at least Phase M44
No vitest.config.ts or separate test runner config exists that would produce 688
The 688 figure does not appear in any P1.25/P1.26/P1.27 test_report.json artifacts
source_of_688.conclusion: 688 was a documentation artifact, not a real vitest count. 414 is correct.

p129_action: Carry 414 as the canonical frontend suite count for P1.29. No frontend test changes introduced.
verdict: PASS — 414 is canonical. 688 was a prior-phase documentation error.
